verdict.rationale: Anrok is a hosted sales-tax SaaS. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of software product, but nothing in the evidence shows any open-source code, public repository or open license. The published OpenAPI spec and API docs describe the API interface, not product source code, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
